# OdooTeams

> Professional Odoo ERP implementation, customization, migration, training, and continuous support services worldwide with specialized MENA & GCC localizations.

OdooTeams is a global enterprise solutions provider and certified Odoo development agency. We assist small, medium, and large enterprises in adopting, migrating to, and scaling Odoo ERP (Odoo Community & Enterprise editions, versions 14 through 18+). The platform supports bilingual operations in English and Arabic with localized business workflows.

Full documentation and complete knowledge base available at: https://odooteams.com/llms-full.txt

## Key Services

- [Full Odoo ERP Implementation](https://odooteams.com/services/odoo-implementation): End-to-end deployment including requirement analysis, business blueprinting, module configuration, data migration, user training, and go-live support.
- [Custom Module Development](https://odooteams.com/services/custom-module-development): Tailored Python/XML Odoo module development, UI customization, workflows automation, and business logic extensions.
- [Odoo Version Migration & Upgrades](https://odooteams.com/services/odoo-migration): Upgrading legacy Odoo databases (Community to Enterprise, or older versions to Odoo 17/18) with complete data integrity.
- [Third-Party Integrations & APIs](https://odooteams.com/services/third-party-integrations): Bi-directional API connectors for Payment Gateways (Stripe, PayPal, HyperPay, PayTabs, Tabby, Tamara), eCommerce (Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, Amazon), Shipping (DHL, FedEx, Aramex, SMSA), and CRM systems.
- [GCC & MENA Localizations](https://odooteams.com/services/odoo-localization): Saudi ZATCA Phase 1 & 2 e-invoicing compliance, UAE Federal Tax Authority (FTA) 5% VAT & Corporate Tax accounting, Egyptian e-Invoice/e-Receipt SDK integration, and GCC WPS Payroll.
- [Managed Odoo Hosting & DevOps](https://odooteams.com/services/odoo-hosting): Scalable cloud deployment on AWS, Google Cloud, DigitalOcean, and Odoo.sh with automated daily backups, SSL, staging environments, and 99.9% uptime SLA.
- [Training & Knowledge Transfer](https://odooteams.com/services/odoo-training): Role-based training workshops for end-users, administrators, and developers in English and Arabic.
- [24/7 SLA Support & Maintenance](https://odooteams.com/services/odoo-support): Dedicated bug fixing, performance monitoring, monthly maintenance, and on-demand functional consulting.

## Core Modules & Functional Coverage

- **Accounting & Finance**: General Ledger, Multi-currency, Bank Reconciliation, Asset Management, Budgeting, Analytic Accounts, ZATCA / FTA VAT Reporting.
- **Supply Chain & Inventory**: Multi-warehouse, Barcode scanning, Lot & Serial tracking, Automated replenishment, Landed costs, Dropshipping.
- **Sales & CRM**: Lead pipeline management, Quotations, Customer portal, Automated invoicing, Commission calculation.
- **Manufacturing (MRP) & PLM**: Multi-level BOM, Work centers, Routing, Capacity planning, Quality control, Maintenance scheduling.
- **Human Resources (HRMS)**: Employee master, Recruitment, Attendance (Biometric integration), Leave management, Payroll with GCC End of Service (EOS) & WPS compliance.
- **Point of Sale (POS)**: Retail and Restaurant POS with offline caching, receipt printers, barcode readers, kitchen display systems, and multi-till management.
- **eCommerce & Website Builder**: Odoo native shop with real-time stock sync, abandoned cart recovery, customer portal, and SEO optimization.
